class.name: SignalHeadKind
class.brief_description: What a kind of signal head can show: its aspects by name.
class.description: What a kind of signal head can show: its aspects by name. A signal head is given its kind with [method SignallingServer.signal_head_set_kind]; the aspects are data, not code, so a new kind of signal head is a new resource.

method.description: The aspect names, in the order they are declared.

method.name: has_aspect
method.description: Whether the kind has the aspect named [param aspect].
